name: Macro yield-curve steepening risk-on — long crypto when the 2s10s is steep
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (orthogonal to every existing spec — yield_curve_2s10s is used by nothing): the 2s10s Treasury slope is the bond market's growth/recession dial. A STEEP (positive, widening) curve prices reflation, ample liquidity and a growth upswing — the macro backdrop in which the highest-beta risk asset (crypto) earns its premium. A FLAT or inverting curve prices a coming slowdown and a liquidity drain. Conditioning a crypto long on a steep-enough curve is a slow, causally-motivated macro-regime filter no crypto-native or vol signal captures (it leads the cycle by quarters, not days). Entry: yield_curve_2s10s above a fitted steepness floor AND price in a non-broken uptrend. Exit: the curve crosses DOWN through a flattening threshold (the cycle is rolling over) or stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if the unconditional trend long matches the deflated Sharpe, the curve gate adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: the 2s10s, credit_spread and vix all proxy the macro regime; if substituting credit_spread does as well this is macro-credit-spread re-skinned — the curve must add orthogonal CYCLE-PHASE information. Disconfirmer 3 (data depth): only ~60 daily curve points exist — this needs more history to be anything but suggestive; flagged low-confidence, paper-only until the series deepens. Disconfirmer 4 (cost): conditional long must beat buy-and-hold deflated Sharpe net of ~20bps. tier0 macro feature.
catalyst: a steep 2s10s curve — reflation/growth macro regime for a crypto long
